text:
[NSTG.5.1] The samples plane forwards each absorbed series
sample to an integrator-supplied callback per [LSER.8.3].
Two callbacks compose:

- **C6 — sample emission.** Fires once per absorbed sample
  during fact assertion, after the firing decision lands
  per [LSER.8.6].
- **C7 — series declaration.** Fires at DSC load time
  once per persisted series (i.e., series with `persist:`
  declared), giving the integrator the manifest needed to
  provision backend storage before any sample arrives.

Both callbacks are independent. An integrator may register
neither (NULL = silent drop matching drop-oldest framing),
one, or both. C7 is for backends that need pre-arrival
setup — relational TSDB hypertables, retention policies,
column-type validation. Without it, the integrator's C6 cb
learns about `(schema, slot)` pairs lazily as samples
arrive (which works for client libraries that auto-create
metrics on first observation: Prometheus, InfluxDB).
